children: announced on Wednesday that it priced an offering of €500M in aggregate principal amount of 4.750% senior notes due 2034.
is expected to close on September 23, 2026, subject to customary conditions.

The company plans to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including funding the consideration for its recently announced acquisition of Walkers Deli & Sausage, along with related costs and expenses.
The offering is not conditioned on the closing of the Walker acquisition.

title: Pilgrim’s Pride prices €500M senior notes to fund Walkers acquisition
